title: Fabrication of Micropatterned Hydrogels for Neural Culture Systems using Dynamic Mask Projection Photolithography
protocol: Mount the DMD board vertically on a vibration isolation table.
Adjust the UV light guide so that the light hits the mirror array at an angle of 45° relative to the plane of the mirrors and 24° below the plane of the mirrors.
Mount the objective lens such that it is positioned at the focal length associated with the lens from the DMD board.
Place an inverted microscope below the objective lens for visualization through the microscope.
Adjust the distance between the objective lens and the polymerization surface to match the working distance of the lens using the stage on the microscope.
Coat the walls of 6-well collagen coated cell culture inserts with Rain-X, avoiding the membrane.
Hydrate the coated inserts overnight in an incubator at 37 °C and 5% CO2 with adhesion medium.
Harvest embryonic dorsal root ganglia (DRG) from E-15 rat pups.
Plate DRG onto collagen-coated 6-well inserts, up to four per insert.
Incubate inserts for 2 hours to allow adherence of DRG to the membrane.
Remove excess liquid from the insert.
Add 500 μl of polymerization medium inside the insert.
Place the insert underneath a digital micromirror device (DMD) on a Rain-X treated glass slide.
Load an appropriate black and white image as a "photomask" using ALP-3 basic GUI program.
Using an inverted microscope for visualization, align tissue explants with the appropriate location on the photomask using a visible light source reflecting off the DMD.
Switch the visible light source to the UV light source.
Illuminate the PEG solution until crosslinking is sufficient.
Wash each insert three times with sterile DPBS and 1% Pen-Strep.
Add 1.5 mL growth medium underneath the cell culture inserts.
Allow to equilibrate in an incubator for 30 minutes.
Remove all excess media from the PEG voids using a sterile cotton tip applicator, Kimwipe, or micropipette.
Dilute 1% Puramatrix according to manufacturer's instructions to 0.15% in sterile H2O and supplement with 1 μg/mL soluble laminin.
Add Puramatrix to the PEG voids using a micropipette without overflowing.
Add 1.5 mL of growth medium underneath the insert and place in the incubator for one hour.
Change the media after one hour to allow pH equilibration.
Remove all excess media from PEG voids carefully.
Dissolve agarose to a 1% solution in growth medium at 60 °C until fully dissolved.
Supplement the agarose solution with 1 μg/mL soluble laminin.
Add agarose to PEG voids, using approximately ~1 μL per construct.
Pre-chill 1.5 mL of growth medium in a 6-well plate (8°C).
Transfer inserts containing agarose to chilled media and refrigerate at 8 °C for three minutes.
Maintain inserts in pre-warmed growth medium (37°C) after transferring them, with regular media changes every 48 hours.
Load an appropriate mask on the DMD.
Treat the walls of a polyester cell culture insert with Rain-X.
Place the treated insert under the DMD on a Rain-X coated slide.
Add 500 μL of polymerization medium to the insert.
Induce PEG crosslinking by exposure to UV light for 55 seconds.
Wash three times with sterile DPBS and 1% Pen-Strep.
Remove all excess media from the PEG voids.
Spin down cells at the desired density into a pellet.
Suspend the cell pellet inside 0.15% Puramatrix diluted in sterile H2O supplemented with 10% sucrose.
Inject the Puramatrix/cell/sucrose mixture inside the voids in PEG.
Add 1.5 mL of growth medium underneath the insert.
Allow the medium to gel inside the incubator for one hour.
Change the media after one hour and every 48 hours thereafter.
Load an appropriate mask on the DMD for single hydrogel encapsulation.
Treat a polyester cell culture insert with Rain-X.
Place the treated insert under the DMD on a Rain-X coated slide.
Mix cells at any desired concentration directly into the 10% PEG solution.
Add 500 μL of polymerization medium to the insert.
Induce PEG crosslinking by exposing to UV light for 55 seconds.
Wash three times with sterile DPBS and 1% Pen-Strep.
Fill with growth medium both below and on top of the insert, changing every ~2 days.
Load an appropriate mask on the DMD for thin film hydrogel polymerization.
Treat a collagen-coated polyester cell culture insert with Rain-X.
Place the treated insert on a Rain-X coated slide.
Add sufficient polymerization medium to just cover the bottom of the insert (~250-300 μL).
Allow the media to permeate the insert membrane for 30-45 minutes at room temperature.
Remove excess polymerization medium from the insert with a micropipette or Kimwipe.
Add UV-transparent oil sufficient to cover the bottom of the insert.
Allow the insert to sit for 15-30 minutes at room temperature.
Place the insert and slide under the DMD.
Expose the insert to UV light for crosslinking at 5.0 Watts/cm2 for 15 seconds.
Wash the insert three times with sterile DPBS and 1% Pen-Strep.
Store the insert in a 6-well tissue culture plate.
Add growth medium to suspended cells to obtain the desired cell density.
Pipette the cell suspension inside the cell culture insert.
Add enough growth medium below the insert for complete maintenance of cell viability (~1.5 mL).
Wash the insert three times with sterile DPBS and 1% Pen-Strep after 48 hours.
Change media approximately once every 48 hours.
